description: 24 original synthetic selected travel episodes, rotating three account profiles. Both actual trip legs, current equipment, assistance proofs, cancelled paid returns or lapsed unpaid holds, and append-only debits/refunds are loaded as business records. This is a selected episode corpus, not an exhaustive daily commute log.

provenance.author: Hanson Tang
